code:
# minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week   command
    0     2        *          *       *         /opt/northbridge/export-inventory.sh
   */15   *        *          *       *         /opt/northbridge/check-queue.sh
    0     9        *          *      1-5        /opt/northbridge/send-daily-report.sh
caption: */15 means every 15 units; 1-5 means Monday through Friday

Full history of every run, no extra setup
code:
$ systemctl list-timers nb-export.timer
NEXT                         LEFT      LAST  PASSED  UNIT
Tue 2026-10-06 02:00:00 UTC  14h left  n/a   n/a     nb-export.timer

$ journalctl -u nb-export.service
caption: cron output gets mailed or dropped silently; a timer's service logs through journalctl
